title: Practice: Two aspects: the process and the result

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: When and where was Beethoven born?
exercises.why: **родиться → родился** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.

exercises.prompt: Looks like the transmission belt broke.
exercises.why: **сломаться → сломался** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.

exercises.prompt: Did you think Marseilles was the capital city of France?
exercises.why: **думать → думал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.q: Ни у кого не ___ (возникать) никаких вопросов касательно плана.
exercises.prompt: No one had any questions about the plan.
exercises.why: **возникать → возникало** — past tense, neut.: drop -ть, add -ло.

exercises.q: Я думаю, она ___ (осознавать), что на неё заглядываются многие парни.
exercises.prompt: I think she was conscious of being stared at by many boys.
exercises.why: **осознавать → осознавала** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.

exercises.prompt: Tom waited a moment before replying.
exercises.why: **выждать → выждал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.q: Несомненное достоинство автоматических дверей в том, что люди больше не ___ (разносить) заразу через дверные ручки.
exercises.prompt: A definite advantage of automatic doors is that people can't spread their contagious diseases by touching door handles.
exercises.why: **разносить → разносят** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The world is not going to be saved by legislation.
exercises.why: **спасти → спасёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Computers will save you a lot of time.
exercises.why: **сберечь → сберегут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
